findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed manifest fails reckon crew check-manifest (ok:false) with 'status is complete but no commit is recorded' and changed paths outside the write scope (the run-directory scripts and logs it lists in changed_paths sit outside its declared orientation_write_paths); the node's own contract required it to run check-manifest and repair what it reports before setting a terminal status, and it closed at status: complete without doing so, so the record will be refused at promotion until it is repaired.
